title: Breath, Rhythm & Bandhas
subtitle: A Geometric & Thermodynamic Framework — From Visceral-Pressure Manifolds to Autonomic Regulation

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Breath, Rhythm & Bandhas” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.explanation: Breath is a periodic dynamical system and bandhas are topological valves; together they control pressure gradients, blood flow, and neural states. The respiratory system is a multi-dimensional state space governed by phases, nostril routing, and topological locks, with valid bandha combinations enumerated across retention phases. A formal generative grammar for pranayama produces execution strings (for example classical Samavritti with Maha Bandha). Frequency dynamics separate high-frequency sympathetic activation from low-frequency parasympathetic resonance, and the hydraulic physics of each lock yields systemic outcomes — turning breathwork into a programmable operating system for autonomic regulation.
blocks.tts: Breath and bandhas as a programmable operating system: a respiratory alphabet and generative grammar controlling pressure, blood flow, and autonomic state.
